purpose: Prospectively distinguish profitable and losing occurrences of a frozen loop orientation by logging causal route state and price-path state without treating realised loop completion, child, morph, MFE, MAE, or payoff as admission information.

summary: Exact parent completion was not a universal positive-payoff state.
An incompatible first transition was profitable at the frozen close in both periods for both primary candidates, so structural route invalidation was not economic invalidation.
The expected first leg followed by a diversion was negative at the frozen close in all four opened candidate-period cells, but this was observed after inspection and is not a validated exit rule.
Next-open exits after completion, invalidation, the first transition, or the first terminal route event failed the frozen paired gates.

activation_requirements: Use only sessions whose raw data and outcomes were genuinely unseen when this contract, model, feature schema, route state machine, costs, and evaluation code were hashed.
Set an activation timestamp before the first observation and forbid backfilling earlier sessions into the prospective evaluation.
Create an append-only ledger and outcome-opening schedule that prevent row replacement after observation time.
Freeze model source or binary hashes, the complete feature availability clock, missingness rules, candidate set, and all uncertainty and abstention thresholds.
Independently audit leakage, provider timestamps, next-open counterfactual clocks, and exact replay before outcomes are opened.

prospective_hypotheses.claim: A calibrated positive/negative/unknown payoff-state model can improve paired net payoff or coverage-quality trade-offs conditional on the frozen loop forecast.
prospective_hypotheses.tuning_source: prospective training windows only; never reopened 2023 or 2025 path outcomes

prospective_hypotheses.claim: A causally detected expected-leg-then-diversion state may identify an unfavorable payoff branch.
prospective_hypotheses.warning: Observed after inspecting all four opened candidate-period cells; must be frozen and evaluated only on new sealed observations.

prospective_hypotheses.claim: The payoff model should distinguish structural incompatibility from adverse price-path state instead of automatically exiting on an incompatible transition.
Completion payoff response differs by parent loop, so any partial pooling must retain a loop-specific completion effect with uncertainty.
Causal running excursion, retracement, and volatility support after a state event may separate a usable move from a move likely to be surrendered.
prospective_hypotheses.warning: No retracement, ATR, bar-count, or price threshold may be selected from opened V2/V3 paths.

model_shape.primary_target: cost-adjusted payoff distribution conditional on frozen loop forecast and current causal path information
model_shape.secondary_target: route-topology probabilities used as auxiliary forecasts, never realised labels at admission
model_shape.estimation: hierarchical partial pooling by loop and route state with time-aware fitting and explicit uncertainty
model_shape.child_or_morph_use: forbidden unless a separately frozen causal forecast with availability timestamps exists

predeclared_evaluation.primary_target: net payoff after 5 bps per side
predeclared_evaluation.primary_comparison: paired against the frozen anchor+24 close on identical hypothetical admissions
requirements: minimum support and coverage for every reported class
multiplicity control across loop, route-state, and policy endpoints
calibration and selective-risk evaluation for unknown/abstain
independent source-hash, leakage, timestamp, and exact-rerun audit
forbidden: choosing a route, transition, bar, retracement, ATR, or payoff threshold from opened results
using realised completion, child, morph, future state, duration, MFE, MAE, or payoff as an admission feature
interpreting parent identity conditional on completion as 100 percent opportunity-level occurrence
promoting any finding directly to live, paper, demo, broker, position, order, deployment, or application functionality

provenance_and_missingness.quotes_or_ticks: unavailable unless a separately frozen source exists
provenance_and_missingness.all_features: store source timestamp, availability timestamp, transform version, missingness reason, and support
